DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昔の道具の展示について、ご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like information about the old-tools exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内に「触って体験」とあります。隣の棚の道具も触ってよいのかと思いましたが、同じ表示は見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 触って体験表示が隣棚の同様道具にも適用か不明と尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: This guide says 'hands-on experience.' I thought I could touch the tools on the neighboring shelf too, but I can't find the same sign there.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the hands-on sign also applies to similar tools on the neighboring shelf, as you are unsure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 触れる案内は、この体験台の品だけです。隣の展示棚には広げず、表示のない品はそのままご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: The permission to touch applies only to the items on this activity table. Don't extend it to the neighboring display shelf; please just look at items without a sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ形の道具でも、隣のものまで持ち上げないようにします。使い方がわからないときは、触る前に説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同形でも隣展示を持ち上げず使い方不明は触る前に説明を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even if a tool has the same shape, I won't pick up the neighboring exhibit. If I don't know how to use it, I'd like to hear an explanation before touching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not lift the neighboring exhibit even if it has the same shape, and want an explanation before touching unfamiliar tools. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 体験台の品なら職員の案内で使い方を紹介します。まずどの動きが気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: For items on the activity table, staff will explain how to use them. Which movement are you interested in first?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どう持つのかを見せてもらいたいです。ただ、見せてもらった後も自己流で強く動かさず、どこまで試せるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち方実演を求め自己流で強く動かさず試せる範囲を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like you to show me how to hold it. Even after watching, though, I won't move it forcefully in my own way; I'll ask how far I can try it.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a demonstration of how to hold it and say you will ask the limits of trying it without forceful improvised movements. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 体験台で試す範囲を説明します。お持ちのバッグは台に当たらないようにしてください。写真のご希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain how much you can try on the activity table. Please keep your bag from hitting the table. Would you also like to take photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 体験の様子を撮りたいです。隣の展示棚にも写ってはいけないものがないか、撮る範囲を先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 体験撮影を希望し隣棚の写込禁止物も含め範囲確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like photos of the activity. Please check the permitted framing first, including whether anything on the neighboring shelf must not appear in photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request photos of the activity and ask to check the permitted area, including prohibited items on the neighboring shelf that might enter the frame. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この区域の撮影表示を一緒に確認しましょう。撮影可と表示された範囲でも、ほかの来館者を写さないよう配慮してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the photography signs for this area together. Even within an area marked as allowing photos, please take care not to photograph other visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 触れる範囲と撮れる範囲を別々に確認します。バッグを体験台から離し、まず職員の実演を見てから許可された範囲だけ試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 触れる範囲と撮影範囲を分けバッグを離し実演後に許可範囲だけ試すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the areas for touching and photography separately. I'll keep my bag away from the activity table, watch the staff demonstration first, and then try only what's allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check touching and photography separately, keep your bag away, and try only the allowed range after the demonstration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では体験台へご案内します。隣の展示は触らずにご覧ください。どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll show you to the activity table. Please look at the neighboring exhibits without touching. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 動物の紹介展示を回るご相談ですね。お連れの方に合わせて考えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about looking around the animal introduction exhibits. Is there anything you'd like to consider for your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもと来ました。短い時間で見ようと思いましたが、子どもが暗い部屋を怖がるので、全部を順番どおりに通るのは難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもが暗所を怖がり短時間でも全展示を順番に回れないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm here with my child. I thought we'd look around in a short time, but my child is afraid of dark rooms, so going through every exhibit in order seems difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your child fears dark places, so you cannot go through all exhibits in order even on a short visit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内図には暗くした映像の区域と、明るい模型の区域があります。映像を通らず、模型側から見る案も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: This map shows a darkened video area and a bright model area. We can also check a route that starts with the models without going through the videos.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明るい模型からにします。最初に怖がる部屋へ入れて慣れさせるのではなく、本人の様子を見ながら回りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明るい模型から選び怖い部屋へ無理に入れず本人の様子を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: We'll start with the bright models. Rather than putting my child into a frightening room first to get used to it, I'd like to look around while watching how they're doing.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the bright models first and say you will observe your child's condition without forcing them into the frightening room. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休憩できる場所も入口側にあります。途中で見学を切り上げる場合、出口への道はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's also a resting place near the entrance. If you finish your visit partway through, this is the route to the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩と出口を先に確かめます。子どもの食べ物がありますが、模型の前で食べさせてよいか、飲食の場所も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩と出口を先に確認し子どもの食べ物を出せる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the resting place and exit first. I have food for my child, and I'd like to know where eating is allowed and whether they may eat in front of the models.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check rest and exit locations first and ask where you may take out your child's food. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この展示区域は飲食しないという掲示です。食べる場合の案内は、休憩場所の表示を別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: The notice says not to eat or drink in this exhibit area. For eating, please check the rest area's signs separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展示中は食べ物を出さず、必要なら休憩の方へ移ります。模型と子どもの写真も、撮ってよい範囲を見てからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示で食べ物を出さず必要なら休憩へ移り模型写真も範囲確認後にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't take food out in the exhibits, and we'll move to the rest area if needed. I'll also check where photos of the models and my child are allowed before taking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not take food out in the exhibit, will move to the rest area if necessary, and will check the area before photographing the models. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮影の案内はこちらです。ほかの方が入る位置や、通路を塞ぐ立ち方は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's the photography guidance. Avoid positions that include other people in the photo or block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見学は模型を中心にし、食事や写真のために通路で止まりません。子どもが疲れたら全部を見る予定にこだわらず、入口側から帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 模型中心で通路を塞がず子ども疲労時は全見学にこだわらず入口側へ帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll focus on the models and won't stop in the passage for food or photos. If my child gets tired, we won't insist on seeing everything; we'll go back out by the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will focus on models without blocking the passage and return toward the entrance if your child tires, without insisting on seeing everything. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では明るい模型の区域と休憩場所をお示しします。お子様の様子に合わせて、どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll show you the bright model area and resting place. Enjoy your visit at a pace that suits your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の道について、お尋ねですか。今はどちらを考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a walking route? Which one are you considering now?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この坂を下りる道なら、行きは楽そうだと思いました。あまり体力がないので、短く歩いて同じ入口へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 体力が少なく下りなら楽と思い同入口への短い散歩を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought this downhill route looked easy on the way out. I don't have much stamina, so I'd like a short walk that returns to the same entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a short walk returning to the same entrance, saying you have little stamina and thought downhill would be easy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ道を戻るなら、帰りは上りになります。往復の負担も含めて、別の道を比べてみませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you return the same way, it will be uphill on the way back. Why not compare other routes, considering the effort of the round trip too?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行きの下りだけを見ていました。帰りに上れなくなってから困らないよう、できれば坂を避ける短い道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行きだけ見たと認め帰りに困らぬよう坂回避の短路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was only looking at the downhill outward part. I'd like a short route that avoids slopes if possible, so I don't get stuck unable to climb back up.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit you considered only the outward journey and ask for a short route avoiding slopes to prevent trouble on the return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図には、この広場沿いに坂の印がない短い道があります。休む場所の希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: The map has a short path along this square with no slope symbol. Do you have any preferences for resting places too?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で一度座れる場所を知りたいです。近道の階段があっても、そこを使わずに戻る案にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中の座席を尋ね近道階段を使わず戻る案を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to know somewhere I can sit once along the way. Even if there's a stairway shortcut, please plan a return without using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about a seat along the way and request a return plan that does not use the stairway shortcut. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらのベンチの印をご覧ください。広場沿いを戻れば階段の近道は使わない案ですが、現地の表示も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at this bench symbol. Returning along the square would avoid the stairway shortcut, but check the signs on site too.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチが空いていることまでは保証されないので、必ず座れる前提で奥まで行かないようにします。入口へ戻る目印も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベンチ空席保証を前提に奥へ行かず入口へ戻る目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: A free bench isn't guaranteed, so I won't go deep into the route assuming I can definitely sit. Please also tell me a landmark for returning to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not go far assuming a bench seat is guaranteed, and ask for a landmark to return to the entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口側の案内板が目印です。疲れ方に合わせて早めに戻り、表示がわからなければ職員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: The information board on the entrance side is the landmark. Turn back early according to your fatigue, and ask staff if the signs are unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 坂の往復ではなく、広場沿いで案内板へ戻る短い道にします。ベンチだけを目標に進み続けず、疲れたらその前でも戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 坂往復でなく広場沿い案内板帰還を選び疲労時はベンチ前でも戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose the short route along the square back to the information board, rather than a round trip on the slope. I won't keep going just to reach the bench; I'll turn back before it too if I'm tired.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the short route along the square back to the board instead of the sloping round trip, and say you will turn back even before the bench if tired. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では広場沿いの案内をお持ちください。帰りのことも考えて無理のない範囲で。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take the guide for the square-side route. Think about the return too, and stay within your limits. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご利用ですね。タオルなどの持ち物を一緒に確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. Shall we check your towels and other belongings together?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さいタオルは持っていますが、体を拭く大きいものがありません。ここで借りられるものと料金を、入る前に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小タオル持参だが大きい体拭き用がなく入場前に貸出と料金を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a small towel, but no large one for drying my body. I'd like to know what I can rent here and the charges before entering.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought a small towel but lack a large drying towel, and ask about rentals and charges before entry. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸出品の案内をご覧ください。ここに大きさと料金を分けています。お持ちのものも含めて、必要な数をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please look at the rental guide. Sizes and charges are shown separately here. Choose the number needed, including what you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きいものを一枚借りる条件を確認します。小さいタオルも持参済みなので、全部のセットを自動で頼むつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きい一枚の条件を確認し持参小タオル込みで全部セットを自動注文しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll check the conditions for renting one large towel. Since I've already brought a small one, I don't intend to automatically order the whole set.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the conditions for one large towel and say you will not automatically order the whole set because you brought a small towel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きいものの貸出についてご案内します。着替えや荷物はロッカーを使う案内ですが、使い方も確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain the large-towel rental. The instructions say to use lockers for clothes and luggage; would you like to check how to use them too?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。受付票の番号とロッカーの番号が違うので、同じ番号の場所へ入れるのだと思わず、どれを使うか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付票とロッカー番号が違い同番号へ入れるとせず使用場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The number on my reception slip differs from the locker numbers, so I want to ask which to use rather than assume I put my things in the one with the same number.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the reception-slip and locker numbers differ, and ask which to use without assuming the same number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付票は利用の確認用です。使えるロッカーと鍵の扱いは、こちらの係がご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: The reception slip is for confirming your use of the facility. This attendant will explain which lockers are available and how to handle the key.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 係の説明を聞くまで荷物を入れて閉めません。携帯も持っていますが、浴室内へ撮影のために持ち出すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明前に荷物を閉じ込めず携帯を浴室撮影に使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't put my belongings in and lock it until I hear the explanation. I also have a phone, but I don't intend to take it into the bathing area for photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not lock belongings away before the explanation or use your phone for bathing-area photos. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 浴室は撮影しないという掲示をご確認ください。貴重品の保管と、貸出タオルの返却先も合わせてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the notice prohibiting photography in the bathing area. We'll also explain storage of valuables and where to return rental towels.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号と鍵、貴重品の扱い、タオル返却先を確かめます。大きいタオル一枚の料金と利用方法がわかってから、受付をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号鍵貴重品タオル返却を確認し一枚料金と方法説明後に受付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the number, key, valuables handling, and towel-return location. Once I understand the charge for one large towel and how to use the facility, please process my admission.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the number, key, valuables, and towel return, and request reception processing after the one-towel charge and usage explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では貸出一枚とロッカーの説明から承ります。準備ができてからご利用ください。どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll start by explaining the rental of one towel and the lockers. Please use the facility once you're ready. Enjoy a relaxing time.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の確認をします。今日はお一人で先に到着されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check your reservation. Have you arrived ahead of the other person by yourself today?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で同じ部屋を予約しています。連れは今夜遅く来ますが、私だけ先に来ました。連れの宿泊が明日からという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同室二人予約で連れは今夜後着で翌日から宿泊ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: We've booked the same room for two people. My companion is coming late tonight, and I've arrived first. It doesn't mean their stay starts tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain it is a shared-room booking for two and your companion arrives later tonight, not to start staying the following day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ今夜の予約で、到着時刻が違うということですね。ご予約の控えを確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it's the same booking for tonight, with different arrival times. Please let me check your reservation copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。二人分の予約を一人に変更したいわけではありません。泊数と部屋もこの控えのままにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えを示し人数を一人へ変えず泊数部屋も維持したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I don't want to change the two-person booking to one. I'd like the number of nights and room to stay as shown here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the reservation copy and say you want to keep two people, the number of nights, and the room unchanged. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約内容は維持して確認します。お連れの方が到着したときの受付について、必要な確認事項をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check while keeping the booking details. I'll explain what needs confirming at reception when your companion arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が受付したら連れも何もせず部屋へ入れるとは思っていません。本人がどこへ行き、何を示すか、連れにも伝えられるよう教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分受付で連れも無手続とせず到着時の場所と提示物を本人へ伝えたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't assume that once I check in, my companion can enter the room without doing anything. Please tell me where they should go and what to show so I can tell them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume your check-in removes your companion's procedures; ask where they should go and what to show on arrival so you can tell them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着時は受付で本人の確認をする案内です。鍵の扱いも受付にご相談ください。こちらから連絡を取れる方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: The instructions are for identity verification at reception on arrival. Please discuss the key arrangements with reception too. Is there a way for us to make contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連れと電話で連絡できます。鍵を入口の外へ置いておくようなことはせず、本人が受付へ来ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連れと電話可能で鍵を外へ放置せず本人が受付へ来ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can contact my companion by phone. I won't leave the key outside the entrance or anything like that; I'll tell them to come to reception in person.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can call your companion, will not leave the key outside, and will tell them to come to reception. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお伝えください。今のお客様分の確認書類と予約内容を見て、先に進められる手続きを担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them that. The staff member will look at your verification documents and the booking details and explain which procedures can be done for you first.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の本人確認と、連れが後着する同じ二人予約であることを確認してください。連れの分が全部済んだと伝えず、到着後の受付案内をそのまま知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認と後着の二人予約を確認し連れ分完了とはせず受付案内を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please verify my identity and that this is the same two-person booking with my companion arriving later. I won't say everything for them is done; I'll pass on the arrival reception instructions exactly.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request your identity check and confirmation of the two-person booking with a later arrival, and say you will pass on reception instructions without claiming your companion's procedures are complete. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではご本人分の確認から承ります。お連れの方も到着時に受付へお越しください。ご来館ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll start with your own verification. Please have your companion come to reception on arrival too. Thank you for visiting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りのご相談ですね。ご希望の商品はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss takeaway. Which product are you interested in?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この冷たいデザートです。受け取ってから友人の所へ寄り、最後に家で食べたいので、その間も同じ状態で持てるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷たいデザートを友人宅経由で家へ持帰り同状態を保てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: This cold dessert. After collecting it, I'll stop at a friend's place and finally eat it at home, so I'd like to know whether it can stay in the same condition meanwhile.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the cold dessert can maintain its condition when taken home via a friend's house. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持ち歩く間の状態は保証できません。包装だけで長い寄り道に対応できるとは案内できませんので、ご予定を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't guarantee its condition while being carried. We can't advise that packaging alone can accommodate a long detour, so may I ask about your plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寄り道にかかる時間もまだ決まっていません。保冷の包みを付ければ何時間でもよいとは考えず、受取りの予定から見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 寄道時間未定で保冷包装を無期限保証とせず受取予定を見直したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't decided how long the detour will take either. I won't think cooling packaging makes any number of hours all right; I'd like to reconsider the collection plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the detour time is undecided and you want to reconsider collection without treating cooling packaging as an unlimited guarantee. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰宅前に受け取る案なら、希望の受取枠と商品の扱いを確認します。先に注文済みではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you collect just before going home, we'll check the collection slot you want and how the product is handled. You haven't already ordered, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ注文していません。帰宅前に受け取れるなら候補にしますが、売り切れや準備の条件があるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未注文で帰宅前受取を候補にし在庫や準備条件も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't ordered yet. I'll consider collecting before going home if possible, but I'd also like to ask about possible sellouts and preparation conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not ordered and are considering collection before going home, and ask about stock and preparation conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その時間に用意できるか、担当へ確認します。受取時刻が決まっても、持帰り後の扱いは商品の案内をお読みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the staff member whether it can be prepared at that time. Even once collection time is set, please read the product guidance on handling it after taking it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 商品ごとの注意を確認します。家に着くまでの道でも放置せず、わからない保存方法を自分で決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 商品注意を読み帰宅途中も放置せず不明保存を自己判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the product-specific precautions. I won't leave it unattended on the journey home either or decide an unclear storage method on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will read product precautions, not leave it unattended on the way home, and not decide unknown storage methods yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 注意事項を確認してからお選びください。今回の問い合わせだけで、取り置きや注文が成立したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose after checking the precautions. This inquiry alone hasn't established a hold or order.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 注文済みとは思わず、受取枠と注意、合計額を聞いてから決めます。帰宅前に寄れない場合は、今日はこの商品の持帰りをやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未注文と理解し枠注意総額後に判断し帰宅前受取不可なら持帰りをやめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't think I've ordered. I'll decide after hearing the slot, precautions, and total. If I can't stop by just before going home, I won't take this product away today.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand it is not ordered, decide after hearing the slot, precautions, and total, and say you will give up takeaway if collection before going home is impossible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では帰宅前の受取ができるか照会します。商品はまだ確保していませんので、回答をお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check whether collection before going home is possible. The item hasn't been reserved yet, so please wait for the reply. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業前の確認です。今日の担当について、先に伝えておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the pre-work check. Is there anything you want to tell us first about today's assignment?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来る途中で、別の班の人に「あちらの資材も片付けて」と言われました。まだ手を付けていませんが、朝の担当に含まれるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別班から追加片付けを頼まれ未着手で朝担当に含むか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: On my way here, someone from another team told me to clear away those materials too. I haven't touched them yet, but I'd like to ask whether that's part of this morning's assignment.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say another team requested additional clearing, you have not started, and ask whether it is part of the morning assignment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その場の依頼だけで始めずに確認してください。どの場所を示されたか、図で教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't start just on an on-the-spot request; check first. Can you show me on the diagram which location they indicated?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この区域を指されました。私の担当表の区域とは違います。置いてある物が似ているから、同じ作業だと判断はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図で担当表と違う区域を示し似た資材でも同作業と判断していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: They pointed to this area. It's different from the area on my assignment sheet. I haven't judged it to be the same work just because the materials look similar.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the different area from your assignment sheet on the diagram and say similar materials do not make you assume the same task. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 区域の違いを責任者に確認します。他の班の作業がある場所なので、通り抜けも自己判断でしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the area difference with the supervisor. Another team is working there, so don't decide on your own to pass through either.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認前には入りません。今日使える経路と、自分の担当範囲を示してもらってから、追加依頼の扱いを責任者に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認前に入らず許可経路と担当範囲を示してから追加依頼の扱いを責任者へ確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't enter before checking. After being shown today's permitted route and my assigned scope, I'd like to ask the supervisor how to handle the additional request.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not enter before checking and want the supervisor to clarify the additional request after showing the permitted route and assigned scope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加するかは責任者の指示で確認します。運ぶ物や道具、必要な保護具も、見た目だけで同じと考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll confirm whether it is added through the supervisor's instructions. Don't assume the items to carry, tools, or protective equipment needed are the same just by appearance either.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日使った道具だから今日も許可済みとは考えません。資材に触る前に、対象と道具の説明、保護具、操作の権限を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨日道具の許可を今日へ広げず対象道具保護具操作権限を資材接触前に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't think tools used yesterday are already approved today too. Before touching materials, I'll check the items and tools explanation, protective equipment, and authority to operate them.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not extend yesterday's tool permission to today; say you will check items, tools, protection, and operation authority before touching materials. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不明な点があれば未着手のまま報告してください。依頼した方には、いま確認中だと伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: If anything is unclear, report it without starting. You can tell the requester that it is being checked now.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 頼んだ方には責任者へ確認中と伝えます。急いでいると言われても、自分の判断で担当外の区域へ入り片付けを始めることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 依頼者へ責任者照会中と伝え急いでも自己判断で別区域作業を始めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell the requester that I'm checking with the supervisor. Even if they say it's urgent, I won't decide on my own to enter an area outside my assignment and start clearing.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the requester you are checking with the supervisor and will not independently start work in another area even if urgent. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では今日の担当と追加依頼を責任者に照会します。指示が明確になるまで、指定の待機場所でお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll ask the supervisor about today's assignment and the additional request. Please wait at the designated waiting place until the instructions are clear. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座を作るご相談ですね。主なご利用目的を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss opening an account. May I ask its main purpose?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与の受取りに使いたいです。会社から準備するよう言われましたが、働き始めるのは来週で、まだ出勤していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座目的だが就業開始は来週で未出勤と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to receive my salary. My employer told me to prepare one, but I start work next week and haven't attended work yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the purpose is a salary account but employment starts next week and you have not begun work. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務予定と、すでに勤務していることは分けて伺います。勤務先の資料や本人確認のために持参したものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll distinguish planned employment from already working. Have you brought employer information or anything for identity verification?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードと採用の案内があります。就業中と書く欄を見ましたが、来週からの予定を今日もう働いているように書きたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 在留カードと採用案内を示し予定を現在就業中と記入したくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my residence card and hiring information. I saw a field saying currently employed, but I don't want to write next week's plan as if I'm already working today.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your residence card and hiring information and say you do not want to record future work as current employment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の状況を担当へ正確に伝えてください。どの資料を確認するか、申込みが可能かも、個別にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please accurately tell the staff member your current situation. We'll explain individually which documents to check and whether an application is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この採用案内だけで必ず開設できるとは思っていません。現在の状況で必要なものと、会社へ追加で確認する内容を整理してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 採用案内で必ず開設とはせず現状の必要物と会社への追加確認を整理してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't assume this hiring information alone guarantees an account. I'd like you to organize what's needed for my current situation and what else to check with my employer.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume hiring information guarantees an account; ask to organize current requirements and additional checks with the employer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報を担当へ確認します。会社への提出期限もありますか。開設までの時期はここで確約できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the staff member what information is needed. Is there also a deadline for submitting it to your employer? We can't promise here when the account will be opened.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 期限は言われていますが、できると会社へ先に約束しないでおきます。確認に時間がかかる場合、会社へどこまで進んだと説明すべきか区別したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限があっても会社へ開設確約せず確認に時間がかかる際の段階を区別したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've been given a deadline, but I won't promise my employer in advance that it can be done. If checking takes time, I'd like to distinguish the stage I should explain we've reached.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that despite the deadline you will not promise account opening to your employer and want to distinguish progress stages if checking takes time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談、申込みの受付、開設の完了は別の段階です。担当の説明を聞き、どの段階かを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consultation, acceptance of an application, and completion of account opening are separate stages. Listen to the staff member's explanation and check which stage you're at.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はまず相談です。申込欄でわからない言葉を聞き、勤務予定と書類を確認してから署名するか判断します。受付だけで開設済みとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: まず相談で未知語と勤務予定資料を確認後に署名判断し受付を開設完了と伝えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today is first a consultation. I'll ask about unfamiliar application terms, check the planned employment and documents, then decide whether to sign. I won't report application acceptance as an already opened account.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say it is initially consultation, you will decide on signing after checking unfamiliar terms, work plans, and documents, and will not describe acceptance as completed opening. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは勤務開始前のご相談として担当へご案内します。必要資料と次の段階をお確かめください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll guide you to the staff member as a consultation before starting employment. Please check the required documents and next stage. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札へ入る前にご案内します。点検のため、今は列車が動いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you enter the ticket gates, let me explain. Trains are not running now because of an inspection.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三十分後に取引先と会う予定です。再開まで、どのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三十分後の約束を伝えて運転再開の見通しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm scheduled to meet a business client in thirty minutes. How long will it take for service to resume?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your appointment in thirty minutes and ask about the outlook for service resumption. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 再開時刻はまだ出ていません。お約束の場所は駅の中ですか、外ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: A resumption time hasn't been announced yet. Is your meeting place inside or outside the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相手の事務所です。乗ってから連絡するつもりでしたが、先に遅れる可能性を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待ち合わせ先が事務所だと説明し先に遅延連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: At their office. I was going to contact them after boarding, but I'll tell them first that I may be late.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the meeting is at an office and decide to notify them of possible delay first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのほうがよいですね。切符をお持ちでしたら、まだ改札に通さずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's better. If you have a ticket, please wait without putting it through the gates yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切符はまだ買っていません。待っている間、運行情報はどこで確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未購入だと伝えて運行情報の確認場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't bought a ticket yet. Where can I check service information while waiting?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not bought a ticket and ask where to check service information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この改札横の表示が更新されます。電話は入口をふさがないベンチの脇でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The display beside this gate is updated. Please make calls beside the bench where you won't block the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチの脇へ移ります。相手が迎えに来る場合、駅員さんに車の手配も頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話する場所を確認し迎えの車の手配を頼めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move beside the bench. If the other person comes to pick me up, can I also ask station staff to arrange a car?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the place to make a call and ask whether staff can arrange the pickup car. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車の手配はこちらではできません。迎えの場所は、お相手と施設の表示を確認してお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can't arrange a car here. Please decide the pickup location with the other person, checking the facility signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、迎えを頼むか相手に相談して、表示を見てから切符を買うか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手への相談と表示の確認を済ませてから切符の購入を判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll discuss asking them to pick me up and decide whether to buy a ticket after checking the display.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide about buying a ticket after consulting the other person and checking the display. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 切符の購入は予定が決まってからで大丈夫です。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's fine to buy a ticket once your plans are settled. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 工芸体験の案内をご覧ですね。展示だけの見学もできますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the craft-experience guide. You can also just view the exhibits.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の体験に参加したいのですが、この「受付終了」と「開始」はどう違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌日の体験案内の受付終了と開始の違いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to join tomorrow's activity. What's the difference between registration closes and starts here?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between registration closing and starting on tomorrow's activity guide. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内では、一時半までに受付を済ませ、二時に作業を始めるという意味です。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this guide, it means completing registration by one thirty and starting the work at two.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二時に来ればよいと思っていました。一時半に間に合わなければ、展示だけ見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一時半に遅れた際の展示のみの見学を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I just needed to come at two. If I can't make one thirty, can I just see the exhibits?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether you can view only the exhibits if late for one thirty. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示は別の受付です。ただし体験は人数確認があるので、遅れる場合は体験担当にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The exhibits have separate reception. However, the activity involves checking participant numbers, so if you'll be late, please consult the activity staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同行者は作らずに見ていたいそうです。付き添いも人数に含めるのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 付き添い一人を定員に数えるか知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My companion would like to watch without making anything. I'd like to ask whether companions also count toward the capacity.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to know whether one accompanying person counts toward capacity. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 付き添いの扱いは私の資料ではわかりません。この案内の体験担当への問い合わせ欄をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: My information doesn't say how companions are handled. Please use the inquiry section for the activity staff on this guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話する前に、参加者一人と付き添い一人だとメモしておきます。予約番号も伝えるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 参加人数を整理して問い合わせ時の予約番号の必要性を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before calling, I'll note one participant and one accompanying person. Should I also give a reservation number?
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Organize the participant numbers and ask whether a reservation number is needed for the inquiry. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約済みなら番号もお伝えください。まだ予約されていなければ、空き状況からお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you've booked, give the number too. If you haven't booked yet, start by asking about availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約はしていません。空きと付き添いの条件を担当に聞き、それから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未予約だと明かし空きと付き添いの条件を聞いてから申し込む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't booked. I'll ask the staff about availability and companion conditions, then apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have no reservation and will apply after asking about availability and companion conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内用紙はこちらをお持ちください。ご検討ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-047-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this information sheet. Thank you for considering it.
